nom: PEACH & LILY Lazy Day All-In-One Moisture Pads

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin generally say the pads need a moisturizer layered on top afterward, though a few still find them adequately hydrating for travel or touch-ups.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report mixed results: several say the pads never irritate their skin and are gentle enough for rosacea-prone skin, while others find them too harsh and one reports severe breakouts and redness.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin found the pads not hydrating enough on their own.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the pads keep skin clean and toned, with one saying they minimize pores without clogging them, though additional moisturizer may still be needed some days.

concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the pads as hydrating and refreshing, but several with dry or dehydrated skin say they still need to apply a separate moisturizer afterward for enough moisture.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea-prone sensitive skin reports no flare-ups from these pads; another reviewer without typically sensitive skin experienced redness and irritation after repeated use.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some use the pads specifically during breakout periods to keep routines minimal and help skin heal; however, one reviewer reports severe, repeated breakouts after using the pads several days in a row.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes slight oiliness later in the day if the pad isn't patted in fully.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky residue after drying
Convenient for travel and lazy days
Off or noticeable smell before drying
Liquid settles unevenly in jar over time

extraits.texte: I do not have sensitive skin and I use both the gel water moisturizer and the glass refining serum from Peach and Lily so when I saw these I thought what a great idea for when I don't want to do a full skincare routine or for when I'm traveling to pack lighter. These broke me out so bad! I didn't know it was the pads at first as I only used it once and had a single pimple so I thought nothing of it. When I packed these for a trip instead of a full skincare routine that was a huge mistake. It started with just a few breakouts to which I thought was weird as I normally don't get them, but figured it must be stress related or something. On the third day in a row of using them my skin was red, irritated, and covered in zits. DO NOT USE THESE. Their other products are good. I love the gel moisturizer and glass serum, but these pads are evil
These are fantastic and would work great for someone with less moisture needs. For me… i had to add a moisturizer on top each time. Not a deal break and honestly still great for travel.

I adore Peach & Lily and i own several of their products. I struggle with my mental health and many days i can barely wash my face, let alone do my full skincare routine. Thanks to these, i can take care of my skin without 5-6 steps. The only critique is that i typically have to moisturize after despite its claim to be a moisturizer as well. For reference, i have slightly dry, dehydrated skin.
I always use this while traveling and find them very helpful! I have sensitive skin and it does not irritate my skin.

As a first-time mom, these toner-serum-moisturizer pads are literally lifesaving. Skincare is a huge part of my self-care, and to be able to engage with it even in a two-step kind of way (shout out Power Calm cleanser!) is very important to me. I do notice slight oiliness later on in the day if I forget to pat it in after swiping the pad, but that's something I'm totally willing to put up with because of the ease and simplicity they provide. It smells vaguely floral and nice! but not perfumed. It never feels sticky, just nourishing. I do think in the jar format over time the liquid settles to the bottom of the stack, but you can just take another cotton pad and press hard on the stack to resaturate the top ones. In the travel packs of six this is easily remedied by squishing it around while closed. PLEASE don't discontinue this product I love it so much!!!!

I use these pads at night after a long day of work sometimes I dont want to do my whole skin care routine and these pads make my skin look flawless when I wake up in the mornings, as if i had done my entire skin care routine. I doubted this product but it does the job and feels absolutely amazing. I have combination skin but it works, and it minimizes my pores without clogging them. I also decided to use these for the days I had breakouts, to keep my routine minimal and it healed my skin very well. 10/10 product.

I use these pads more often than not! They are refreshing on my sensitive skin and don't cause flare-ups of my rosacea. It is so hard to find products for sensitive/rosacea prone skin so when I tried these I was skeptical, even though P&L are known for sensitive skin friendly products. I'm so glad I did, and that they FINALLY came back in stock. I'm planning on stocking up myself. 10/10 recommend
